headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) and heavy weights (font-black or font-extrabold) for massive impact.

body.rules: Clean, neutral, and readable. Use leading-relaxed for long form text.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24.
layouts.container: Max width 7xl with mx-auto and px-6 md:px-12 padding.
layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical, high visual tension. Avoid standard equal-width columns where possible.

motion.hover: Harsh, immediate transitions. -translate-y-1, sharp box-shadow additions (e.g., solid 4px black shadow on hover).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up using framer-motion. Keep it quick (0.4s) to match the Brutalist vibe.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px or 2px solid #0A0A0A borders around cards to create a 'blueprint' or 'architectural' feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, solid shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]) instead of soft diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section background to kill digital flatness.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none) or very slight radius (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary CTA should be the accent color (#FF4F00) with white text, or solid black with white text. Hover states should invert or add a hard shadow.
components_strategy.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px black borders. No soft shadows. Padding inside should be generous (p-8).
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky top, solid white background with a 1px bottom border. Z-index 50.

sections.name: Header
sections.content: Logo on left (Marketo). Links on right: 'Login', 'Become a Seller' (Solid Button).
sections.rules: Solid background (bg-white). Do not use transparent over hero.

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Grid cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center min-h-[80vh]

content.headline: Zero Commission. 100% Yours.
content.subheadline: Open your shop, share your link, and get paid directly to your Razorpay account. No hidden fees. No holding periods.

sections.style: Massive headline (text-6xl md:text-8xl+), tracking-tighter, font-black. Left-aligned content spanning 7 columns. Right 5 columns can feature an overlapping collage of the artisan and packing images.

sections.name: How It Works (Bento Grid)
sections.layout: 3-column CSS Grid or dynamic Bento format.

step_1.title: 1. Create your shop
step_1.desc: Claim your URL and set up in minutes.

sections.style: Cards with hard 1px borders. Use the provided images in a cropped, high-contrast style.

sections.name: Why Marketo
sections.style: Stark typography. Heavy use of the accent color for the '0%'.

sections.name: Pricing Teaser
sections.style: Highlight the Yearly plan with a stark inverted scheme (black card, white text) or the accent color.

sections.name: Social Proof
sections.content: Greyed out placeholder cards with 'Testimonial coming soon' and placeholder stats (e.g., '₹10M+ earned by sellers').
sections.style: Opacity 50%, muted grayscale to indicate placeholder status while maintaining the grid.

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Massive typography 'Build Your Empire.', flex row for links.
sections.content: Links: About, Terms, Privacy, Contact. Copyright.
sections.style: Dark background (bg-neutral-900) with white text to contrast the rest of the page. Huge text at the top of the footer.

packing_order.description: Person packing a small business order
packing_order.placement: How it Works - Step 2 or Hero collage

artisan_working.placement: How it Works - Step 1 or Hero collage

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. Black text on white/grey backgrounds, white on black/accent.
accessibility.aria: All buttons and links must have aria-labels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-start-selling-btn').

seo.meta: Include robust title '<title>Marketo | Zero Commission Marketplace</title>' and meta description.
seo.schema: Implement Schema.org Organization and WebSite JSON-LD in the Head.
seo.semantics: Ensure rigid h1, h2, h3 structure. H1 strictly for the Hero.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi' fonts via the provided fontshare URLs in the root CSS/HTML.
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons for UI iconography.
Build standard React (.js or .jsx) components, not .tsx.
Do NOT center-align all text; adhere strictly to optical alignment, mostly left-aligned for tension.
Implement the layout with pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections (do not rely on rigid Shadcn Cards for creative bento layouts).
Create stub routes or distinct sections for About, Terms, Privacy, Contact as requested by the footer.
Preserve the 'visit a shop by slug' logic or ensure it's easily accessible in the route structure.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Use targeted transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Implement Sonner for any toast notifications required.
